title: Mecher's PVP pack
description: A pvp texture pack that adds a ton of things for your quality of life
body:
**This pack adds:**
- Blue diamond armour and items
- Blue netherite debris
- Bow/crossbow indicators
- Eating animations
- Invisible gui background
- Outlined web
- Outlined wool
- Clear water
- Low fire/shield
- Custom font(English only)
- Custom crosshair
- Visible attack indicator
- Hardcore hearts in survival
- Small crit particles
- White enchant glint
- Transperent potion particles
- Shorter white elytra
- And many other things I forgot
